verses.1: A song of praise for the children of Korach.
verses.2: Great is Yahweh, and highly praised in our holy city, Mount Qadosh.
verses.3: Beautiful nose, that fills the entire land. Mount Zion is covered with flowers; it’s like a garden of the king.
verses.4: God knows everything in His mysteries.
verses.5: For behold, the kings were moving forward together.
verses.6: They saw this, and they were terrified and scared.
verses.7: A tremor seized them there; a force of destruction was unleashed.
verses.8: In the days to come, the nations will be destroyed.
verses.9: As we heard and saw, in the city of Jehovah, there were armies of angels in our God’s city. God is planning to make it a place for eternal worship.
verses.10: May God’s kindness be with you in your presence.
verses.11: When your name is God, then your praises will fill the earth. Your right hand will be full of blessings.
verses.12: May Mount Zion rejoice, and may the daughters of Judah rejoice for your judgments.
verses.13: They surrounded and enclosed it from its heights.
verses.14: Purify your hearts and minds, so that you may pass on these teachings to future generations.
verses.15: For this is our God, who will rule over us forever. He will guide us along the path of death.
